Sherpur Razakar suspect sent to jail
2016-08-24T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/sherpur-razakar-suspect-sent-jail-1274593

The International Crimes Tribunal-1 yesterday sent SM Aminuzzaman Faruk, an alleged Razakar from Sherpur, to jail after police produced him before it.

Detectives on Monday arrested Aminuzzaman of Eshibpur village in Nokla upazila hours after the tribunal issued an arrest warrant against him for allegedly committing crimes during the 1971 Liberation War.

According to the prosecution, late Shamsuzzaman, father of Aminuzzaman, was the convenor of Nokla Peace Committee, an anti-liberation organisation, and Aminuzzaman a member of local Razakar force, one of the auxiliary forces of Pakistani army in 1971.

Probe in the case began on November 19 last year and investigation officer claimed to have found his involvement in at least two incidents of murder, the prosecution said.

The tribunal fixed October 31 for passing next order in the case.
